inspected_sources.citation: Patrick G. Cesarz and Andrew J. Woldar, On the automorphism group of a putative Conway 99-graph, Algebraic Combinatorics 8 (2025), 379-398
inspected_sources.finding: Published online 2025-04-24; explicitly calls existence an elusive open problem; no Wave 25 numerical or lattice fingerprint.

inspected_sources.citation: Andries E. Brouwer, Parameters of Strongly Regular Graphs, orders 51-100
inspected_sources.finding: The row 99,14,1,2 is marked '?', i.e. undecided in the table legend/context.

inspected_sources.citation: Reimbay Reimbayev, The lower bound for number of hexagons in strongly regular graphs with parameters lambda=1 and mu=2, EJAAM 2024
inspected_sources.finding: Derives hexagon count as a baseline plus n3 and uses only n3>=0; contains no 708, determinant ceiling, idempotent split, or rank-36 obstruction.

inspected_sources.citation: Reimbay Reimbayev, The Subgraphs of Order Six of the Family of Strongly Regular Graphs with Parameters lambda=1 and mu=2, arXiv:2508.03377v2
inspected_sources.finding: Uses n3 as a free variable. Full-text searches found no 708, idempotent, unimodular, or determinant occurrence.

inspected_sources.citation: Robert R. Petro and Connor M. Phillips, On Clique Graphs and Clique Regular Graphs, arXiv:2502.17845
inspected_sources.finding: Gives clique-graph restrictions and still describes the existence question as longstanding; no Wave 25 mechanism.

inspected_sources.citation: Joshua E. Ducey et al., Critical group structure from the parameters of a strongly regular graph, JCTA 180 (2021), 105424
inspected_for: target-specific lattice and arithmetic prior art
inspected_sources.finding: Computes the putative graph's critical group from its parameters; no n3=708 equality-case argument or determinant ceiling.

inspected_sources.citation: Roland Bacher and Boris Venkov, Lattices and association schemes: a unimodular example without roots in dimension 28, Annales de l'Institut Fourier 45 (1995), 1163-1176
inspected_for: rational projector and idempotent lattice prior art
inspected_sources.finding: Section 2 constructs integral Gram matrices and lattices from rational minimal idempotents of association schemes; conceptual prior art, not an exact target match.

inspected_sources.citation: Ichiro Shimada, An even extremal lattice of rank 64
inspected_sources.finding: States the standard fact that an even unimodular lattice has rank divisible by 8; this rules out positive-definite rank 36 once such a lattice is rigorously obtained.

inspected_sources.citation: R. Ibrahim et al., 2-percolation in diameter 2 graphs, Australasian Journal of Combinatorics 93 (2025), 60-89
inspected_sources.finding: Explicitly says it is unknown whether an srg(99,14,1,2) exists.

inspected_sources.citation: Andrew Berget, Andrew Manion, Molly Maxwell, Aaron Potechin, and Victor Reiner, The critical group of a regular line graph
inspected_for: rational orthogonal decomposition and projector-lattice context
inspected_sources.finding: Develops rational orthogonal decompositions, projection maps, determinant groups, and integral Gram presentations in graph-lattice settings; conceptual rather than exact target prior art.
